en.headline: Tin Shui Wai man arrested after early-morning public fight
en.dek: Police said a 32-year-old man was taken to hospital unconscious after a clash near a Tin Heng Estate playground, then arrested on suspicion of fighting in a public place.
body: Police said they received a report from a woman shortly after 3am on Sunday that her 32-year-old husband had been set upon by at least four men on a footpath near a playground at Tin Heng Estate in Tin Shui Wai.

The man suffered a head injury and was found unconscious. He was taken by ambulance to Tuen Mun Hospital. Officers later said they believed he had been drinking and had argued with others before the two groups exchanged blows, and that he had been outnumbered.

He was arrested on suspicion of fighting in a public place. Police said they were still seeking the other people involved. The case is being handled by Yuen Long District’s Criminal Investigation Team 9.

zh.headline: 天水圍天恒邭凌晨鬥鬥 32歲男昏迷送院後被捕
zh.dek: 警方接報一名男子在天恒邭遊樂場附近遭至少四名男子圍毆，頭部受傷昏迷送院，其後涉嫌在公眾地方鬥鬥被捕。
body: 警方表示，週日凌晨約3時接獲一名女子報案，指其32歲丈夫在天水圍天瑞路83號天恒邭行人路近遊樂場與人爭執，其後遭至少四名男子圍毆。
該名男子頭部受傷倒地並陷入昏迷，由救護車送往屯門醫院治理。警方初步調查後相信，他較早前飲酒後因瑣事與人爭執，雙方互毆，他疑寡不敵眾受傷。
警方以涉嫌在公眾地方鬥鬥拘捕該名男子，並追查其餘涉案人士下落。案件交由元朗警區刑事調查隊第九隊跟進。
